package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	backend "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/backend"
	simulation "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/cluster"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/wasi"
	model "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/cluster"
)

func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

type observation struct {
	Rank       uint32              `json:"rank"`
	StartOrder []string            `json:"start_order"`
	Record     model.ClusterRecord `json:"record"`
}

func main() {
	var base wasi.Request
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	check(err)
	check(json.Unmarshal(raw, &base))
	module, err := os.ReadFile(base.ModulePath)
	check(err)
	imports, pages, err := backend.InspectModule(module)
	check(err)
	base.Imports, base.InitialMemoryPages = imports, pages
	base.ModuleSHA256 = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(module))
	base.Config.Args = []string{"fixture", "park"}
	base.Config.Storage, base.Config.NetworkV2 = nil, nil
	base.Runtime.Seed = 89
	base.Runtime.Choice.ExecutionIdentity.TargetSHA256 = sha256.Sum256(module)
	root, err := model.NewExplorationPlan(fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("actual-scenario"))), fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("controller"))), 89, nil)
	check(err)
	run := func(plan model.ExplorationPlan) observation {
		operator := simulation.OperatorScenario{Schema: simulation.OperatorSchema,
			Spec:    model.Spec{Schema: model.SpecSchema, Backend: model.BackendWASM, Fidelity: model.FidelitySimulationModel, Limits: model.DefaultLimits(), Nodes: []model.NodeSpec{{ID: "a", Boot: "park", Address: "10.0.0.1"}, {ID: "b", Boot: "park", Address: "10.0.0.2"}}},
			Boots:   []simulation.OperatorBoot{{ID: "park", Args: []string{"park"}}},
			Actions: []simulation.OperatorAction{{Action: "start", Handle: model.NodeHandle{Node: "a", Incarnation: 1}}, {Action: "start", Handle: model.NodeHandle{Node: "b", Incarnation: 1}}, {Action: "wait", Handle: model.NodeHandle{Node: "a", Incarnation: 1}}, {Action: "wait", Handle: model.NodeHandle{Node: "b", Incarnation: 1}}},
		}
		spec, provider, err := operator.Bind(base)
		check(err)
		spec.Exploration = &plan
		var order []string
		branch := func(nodes ...model.NodeID) model.Scenario {
			return func(ctx context.Context, cluster model.Cluster) error {
				handles := map[model.NodeID]model.NodeHandle{}
				for _, node := range nodes {
					handle, err := cluster.Start(ctx, node)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					handles[node] = handle
					order = append(order, string(node))
				}
				for _, node := range []model.NodeID{"a", "b"} {
					if _, err := cluster.Wait(ctx, handles[node]); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				return nil
			}
		}
		first, err := model.NewScenarioStep("a-first", branch("a", "b"))
		check(err)
		second, err := model.NewScenarioStep("b-first", branch("b", "a"))
		check(err)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		result, err := model.RunWASM(ctx, spec, model.Choose("ready-start", first, second), provider)
		check(err)
		if len(result.Record.ExplorationDecisions) != 1 {
			panic("actual scenario decision missing")
		}
		return observation{Rank: result.Record.ExplorationDecisions[0].Selected, StartOrder: order, Record: result.Record}
	}
	baseline := run(root)
	decision := baseline.Record.ExplorationDecisions[0]
	var observed []observation
	for rank := uint32(0); rank < 2; rank++ {
		forced, err := model.NewExplorationOverride(model.ExplorationScenario, decision.Ordinal, decision.SiteSHA256, decision.Alternatives, rank)
		check(err)
		plan, err := model.NewExplorationPlan(root.ExecutionSHA256, root.ControllerSHA256, 89, []model.ExplorationOverride{forced})
		check(err)
		observed = append(observed, run(plan))
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(observed)
	check(err)
	fmt.Println(string(encoded))
}
